_about: House broadcast profile as a settings record, mirroring the keys of an OBS profile's basic.ini so the values transfer 1:1 at setup time. This file is NOT an importable OBS profile (OBS profiles are a folder: basic.ini + service.json); it is the reviewed, versioned record of what the house profile must contain. Streaming service/key fields are named blanks on purpose — no account or key is invented here.

audio.master_loudness: -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP (house finish law — OBS adds no gain; the file is already loudness-true)

recording.container: mkv (record in MKV, remux to MP4 — OBS crash-safe discipline)
recording.note: CRF 16 matches the house master encode profile in FULLSTACK-WIRING stage 10; a recorded premiere master should be indistinguishable from the file master and must pass the same VMAF gate against it.

streaming.note: 720p24 house format streams comfortably at 6000 kbps; raise canvas rather than bitrate only when a 1080p delivery is actually ordered.
streaming.service: <SET AT FIRST BROADCAST — no service chosen or key stored in this repo>

video.downscale_filter: Lanczos (only used if a scene source exceeds canvas)
video.note: Base = output: the house master format is 1280x720/24 (EP01 masters measured). No scaling in the broadcast chain.
